tips.text: Pay Yourself First: Transfer at least 15% to 20% of any income directly to your savings account before paying discretionary expenses.
tips.author: BudgetBasics Foundation

tips.text: The 24-Hour Buffer Rule: For any non-essential purchase over Rs. 2,000, wait 24 hours to eliminate impulse dopamine spending.
tips.author: Behavioral Finance Standard

tips.text: The Ghost Subscription Check: Review bank statements monthly to cancel forgotten app free trials and unused entertainment tiers.
tips.author: Student Cash Flow Guide

tips.text: Starter Emergency Cushion: Aim for a starter emergency reserve of Rs. 15,000 to insulate yourself against sudden device repairs.
tips.author: Financial Resilience Standard

tips.text: Essential Needs Ceiling: Ensure that your essential survival costs (housing, groceries, transport) never exceed 50% of net income.
tips.author: Macro Allocation Principle

tips.text: Beware of 'Pay Later' Traps: Zero-interest BNPL schemes encourage lifestyle inflation and commit future income before it is earned.
tips.author: Credit Education Advisory
